objective: Define a deterministic, versioned, atomically written integrity manifest for the existing portable training artifact bundle without changing any existing artifact format or public workflow API.
acceptance_criteria: A focused training.artifact_manifest module defines one fixed manifest filename and a versioned JSON schema covering exactly model_definition.json, best_model_state_dict.pt, and class_mapping.json.

Each manifest entry records the canonical relative filename, exact byte size, and lowercase SHA-256 digest, and serialization order and formatting are deterministic across repeated writes for unchanged artifact bytes.

Manifest creation accepts only a single bundle directory and the three fixed regular non-symlink files inside it; missing files, directory entries, symlinks, absolute paths, traversal, duplicate entries, malformed digests, unsupported versions, and unexpected schema structure fail with bounded actionable errors.

The manifest is published with the existing atomic_write_text primitive so encoding or replacement failure cannot expose partial JSON and an existing destination remains intact when publication fails.

Loading and verification distinguish a missing optional manifest from a present invalid manifest, stream file hashing in bounded chunks, and never deserialize model or checkpoint payloads merely to calculate integrity.
The API and documentation in the module describe SHA-256 as corruption and mixed-bundle detection, not cryptographic authenticity or signature verification.
Existing model_definition.json, best_model_state_dict.pt, class_mapping.json, checkpoint, TorchScript, workflow-result, and request formats and public APIs remain unchanged.

Tests use local deterministic bytes and tmp_path to cover stable output, successful verification, changed bytes, changed size, missing artifacts, malformed/version-invalid manifests, unsafe paths, symlinks where supported, bounded chunked hashing, and atomic-write failure without network, CUDA, arbitrary sleeps, marker additions, assertion deletion, or assertion weakening.
Only src/image_ai_studio/training/artifact_manifest.py and tests/training/test_artifact_manifest.py are changed and no Git operation is performed.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 15 CP1 only in src/image_ai_studio/training/artifact_manifest.py and tests/training/test_artifact_manifest.py. Add a deterministic versioned JSON integrity manifest for exactly the existing canonical portable files model_definition.json, best_model_state_dict.pt, and class_mapping.json. Record canonical relative names, byte sizes, and lowercase SHA-256 digests; hash files in bounded chunks and reject missing, non-regular, symlinked, unsafe, duplicate, malformed, or unsupported content with bounded actionable errors. Publish through the existing training.artifact_io.atomic_write_text primitive so failures preserve the prior destination. Expose a small typed API that later workflow and inference checkpoints can call to write, load, and verify a bundle, including an explicit distinction between an absent optional manifest and a present invalid one. Do not change existing artifact formats or public workflow/request/result APIs and do not claim signatures or malicious-tamper authenticity. Add focused deterministic tmp_path tests, preserve all existing assertions, add no marker/dependency, use no network/CUDA/sleep, touch no other file, and perform no Git operation.
estimated_scope: Small integrity contract and focused unit tests, approximately 250-450 changed lines across two new files.
